_comment: THIS TREE'S OWN IDENTITY — the FROM side of every rebrand. tooling/rebrand/rebrand.mjs reads it to know what to rename AWAY from; a product's identity is the --values file, which is the TO side. Change a value here only together with the tree: these strings must be what the tree actually contains, or the rename silently misses and the product ships carrying this baseline's name. `productName` is the SITE_NAME seam in apps/web/site.ts; `slug` also names the D1 databases (terraform `repo`), the secret project and the navbar's repository (apps/web/app/app.config.ts); `pascal` is the code form the leftover sweep looks for, and nothing here spells it — the template's own name is `Content Wind`, with a space, all through its demo content; `domain` and `subdomain` are placeholders, because this baseline has never deployed under a name of its own; `githubOwner` is the owner in the source links the docs and the navbar carry.
